book.title: 校门口的那一次挥手
book.subtitle: 把妈妈的爱装进口袋里

moral.zh: 分开时的不舍很自然；装满安全感的小约定，能陪我们勇敢走进大班。
moral.en: It is natural to feel reluctant when parting; a warm promise filled with love helps us step bravely into our day.

pages.zhText: 清晨，阳光洒在幼儿园大门前的台阶上。红色的欢迎拱门高高立着，许多小朋友正背着书包走进去。
pages.enText: Morning sunlight poured over the kindergarten steps. A welcoming archway stood tall as children walked in with their backpacks.

pages.zhText: 安安站在校门口的大树旁，脚步停住了。她拉着妈妈的手，手指抓得紧紧的。
pages.enText: An'an paused beside the big tree near the gate. She held Mom's hand, her small fingers gripping tightly.

pages.zhText: “我已经上大班了。”安安小声说，可她还是把头靠在妈妈胳膊上。长大了一点，也还是会舍不得。
pages.enText: “I am in the oldest kindergarten class now,” An'an whispered, leaning against Mom's arm. Growing bigger did not mean she never missed Mom.

pages.zhText: 大班的教室在二楼，走廊比以前更长。安安看着那些高高的窗户，觉得幼儿园好像一下子变大了好多。
pages.enText: The senior classroom was on the second floor with longer hallways. Looking up at the tall windows, An'an felt the school had suddenly grown much bigger.

pages.zhText: 妈妈蹲下身来，把安安脸颊边的一缕碎发理到耳后，目光平平地看着她的眼睛。
pages.enText: Mom knelt down, gently brushed a loose strand of hair behind An'an's ear, and met her eyes at eye level.

pages.zhText: “安安是不是觉得，大班的事情又新又多，心里有点没准备好？”妈妈轻声问。
pages.enText: “Does the senior class feel big and new, making you feel a little unready inside?” Mom asked softly.

pages.zhText: 安安点点头，声音小小的：“我想和你在一起。如果我想你了，怎么办呢？”
pages.enText: An'an nodded, her voice very quiet. “I want to stay with you. What if I miss you during the day?”

pages.zhText: 妈妈握住安安的小手，轻轻展开她的手掌。妈妈伸出食指，在安安的手心里画了一个小小的圆圈。
pages.enText: Mom took An'an's hand and gently opened her palm. With her forefinger, Mom drew a small circle in the center.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close-up of hands: Mom's gentle finger traces an invisible circle in An'an's small open palm, warm morning light on skin.

pages.zhText: “这是一颗隐形的小爱心。”妈妈微笑着按了按那块手心，“当你想妈妈时，就合上小手，把它按进心窝里。”
pages.enText: “This is a little invisible heart,” Mom smiled, pressing gently on her palm. “Whenever you miss me, close your hand and press it to your chest.”

pages.zhText: 安安慢慢合拢手指，紧紧攥住手心里的温热，就像真的抓到了一颗红亮亮的小糖果。
pages.enText: An'an slowly curled her fingers into a fist, holding tight to the warmth in her palm as if gripping a shiny little sweet.

pages.zhText: “下午离园时，我会在这棵树下等你。”妈妈指了指大树，“如果接送安排有变化，我会提前告诉老师。”
pages.enText: “I will wait under this tree at pick-up time,” Mom said. “If our plans change, I will let your teacher know beforehand.”

pages.enText: Teacher Lin walked out from the gate, smiling as she offered a welcoming hand. “Good morning, An'an! The cherry tomatoes in our plant corner grew taller today.”

pages.enText: An'an looked back at Mom. Mom smiled and released her hand gently. “Go ahead, An'an. My love is right in your pocket.”

pages.enText: Sunlight filled the classroom. Lele waved from the block corner. “An'an, come help me build a bridge!” She walked over.

pages.enText: At four in the afternoon, the dismissal bell chimed. An'an ran out through the gate; under the big tree, Mom was waiting with open arms.

parentGuide.goal: 接纳入园分别时的依恋情绪，通过具体、可兑现的接送约定帮助孩子安心进入大班生活。
parentGuide.reminder: 不用“都是大班孩子了还不懂事”羞辱难过，不偷偷溜走。分别仪式要温暖而简短，由成人坚守接园时间。
questions: 妈妈在安安手心画了什么？
上学想家的时候，你有什么给自己打气的小办法？
parentGuide.activity: 和孩子一起设计一个专属的“告别击掌密码”或“口袋爱心”，并在入园前练习一次温和道别。

ageTips.age4to5: 允许孩子用指图、点头、手势等非语言方式表达；共读以倾听、感受安抚为主，不强求马上做到。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论大班一日生活中的真实感受与解决策略，鼓励孩子自己提出小行动，家长承担托底支持与陪伴责任。
